# MasaMasa

> A browser-based bakery dough formula calculator and technical production-sheet tool. Website: https://masamasa.eu/

MasaMasa lets bakers calculate ingredient quantities from flour-based percentages, adapt dough profiles, use supported preferments, edit production-stage timings and export PDF production sheets. The interface is available in English, Spanish and Russian.

## Official information

- [MasaMasa calculator](https://masamasa.eu/)
- [English product overview](https://masamasa.eu/about/en/)
- [Resumen en español](https://masamasa.eu/about/es/)
- [Описание на русском](https://masamasa.eu/about/ru/)

## Scope and limitations

- Focus: dough formulation and production guidance, not fillings or frosting.
- Timings are profile estimates and need validation in actual production.
- Editing final-proof duration does not automatically adjust yeast dosage.
- Browser-saved recipes do not automatically sync across devices.

This is a supplementary plain-text overview, not a guarantee of search-engine or AI-system indexing.
